entities.name: Ettore Baranzini
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ettore Baranzini was an Italian prelate of the Catholic Church who was secretary to Cardinal Alessandro Lualdi for fifteen years, Rector of the Pontifical Lombard Seminary from 1920 to 1933, and Archbishop of Siracusa for thirty-five years.
